title: review-harness: .harness/config/review-harness.json
description: Allowances for review-harness. Optional: without it every check runs with the defaults and providers are autodetected. review.py reports an unknown key (top level or inside links, strayDocs, hookBench, codex) as a WARN and ignores it; this schema rejects it. `$`-prefixed keys are comments at every level. Paths and globs are relative to the project root; in globs `*` and `**` both cross `/`, a leading `**/` also matches at the root, and a trailing `/**` also matches the folder itself.

providers.description: Bridges to check. Listing a provider makes its missing bridge a failure instead of a warning; an unknown provider is warned and skipped. null or [] means autodetect: `claude` if .claude/ or CLAUDE.md exists, `codex` if .codex/ or .agents/ exists. Default: autodetect.

requiredHooks.description: Hook file names (in .harness/hooks/) that must be wired by some provider. Default: [].

requireHookSplit.description: true turns a missing half of the hook split (UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse/Stop) into a failure. Default: false.

pointerMaxLines.description: Maximum non-blank lines in an AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md pointer. Default: 12.

ignore.description: Globs excluded from every file scan (pointers, links, stray docs). Generated folders are always skipped. Default: [].

links.description: Check 5, broken backticked links into the harness. Each key left out keeps its default.

exclude.description: Markdown files whose links are not checked. Replaces the default list. Default: [".harness/plans/**", ".harness/reports/**", ".harness/audits/**"] (with the real harness directory when $HARNESS_DIR moves it).

allowMissing.description: Exact paths allowed not to exist (a file an ADR retired on purpose, still named by history). Default: [].

placeholders.description: Substrings that mark a template path. Replaces the default list. Default: ["XX", "000X", "..."].

strayDocs.description: Check 6, AI documentation outside the harness. Each key left out keeps its default.

patterns.description: Markdown outside the harness matching these is stray AI documentation. Replaces the default list. Default: ["**/plans/**", "**/specs/**", "**/adr/**", "**/superpowers/**", "**/.tech_proposals/**"].

subprojectDocs.description: Also flag <dir>/docs/** for every directory that has its own AGENTS.md. Default: false.

allow.description: Globs exempted from the stray-docs check. Default: [].

fail.description: true makes stray docs failures instead of warnings. Default: false.

hookBench.description: Check 7, hook test benches. Each key left out keeps its default.

casePatterns.description: Case files (globs in .harness/hooks/) that count as a bench; {stem} is the hook name without extension, {name} with it. Default: ["{stem}.cases*.tsv"].

testPatterns.description: Test files (globs relative to the project root) that count as a bench, for a hook whose behavior is a script rather than a decision; {stem} and {name} as in casePatterns, e.g. "scripts/test/{stem}.test.mjs". Default: [].

runner.description: Bench runner in .harness/hooks/; a hook it names counts as covered. null or "" means there is no runner. Default: "test-hooks.sh".

require.description: Which hooks fail without a bench: "blocking" (PreToolUse), "all" or "none". The rest warn. Default: "blocking".

exempt.description: Hook names that need no bench (say why in the harness). Default: [].

codex.description: Where Codex looks for the bridge. Each key left out keeps its default.

skillsDir.description: Where Codex discovers repository skills. Default: ".agents/skills".

hooksFile.description: Where Codex hooks are wired. Default: ".codex/hooks.json".

frictionLog.description: Path of the blocks log written by the project's hooks (date<TAB>hook<TAB>reason; $VARS and ~ expand), e.g. "$TMPDIR/<project>-harness-friction.tsv". null or absent: check 10 is skipped. Default: unset.

installCheck.description: Check 9b: the argv (no shell) of a READ-ONLY command that exits non-zero when a copy installed from a catalog drifted from its source, run from the project root, e.g. ["python3", "<catalog>/tools/marketplace.py", "install", "--check"]. null or absent: check 9b is skipped. Default: unset.

comment.description: A comment (for example `$comment`); ignored by review.py.
